objective: Proof: one-knot fewest-states steps keep the start's number of orders (k and lambda); one step from a line makes at most two orders; the zero-cost extensions of a line with up to three knots are exactly the C(n,3) fills, each a second order; from one knot the cheapest three-knot step is the square, unique.
status: Proved 2026-11-17 (referee pending): a single betweenness knot leaves N + d or 2N - d states (at least N + 2: subdivisions and pendants); the one-knot fewest-states rule keeps k and lambda from any start with an adjacent pair; one step from a line makes at most two orders (a line only at the n + 1 placements); a line's zero-cost three-knot steps are exactly its C(n,3) fills, each two orders; from one knot the cheapest three-knot step is the 2 x 2 pattern, unique, then 8 options at n = 5. Cube growth (S6) conjectured.
title: What the cheapest steps keep and make
